d: Tejashwi Yadav On CM Samrat :bihar ki rajniti men mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ko lekar neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne tikha hamla bola hai. pradhanmantri narendr modi ke 21 navanbar ko prastavit bihar daure se pahle tejasvi yadav ne kendr aur rajy sarkar par kaee saval uthae. unhonne bihar ko barh aur sukhe ke lie vishesh paikej nahin milne ka aarop lagaya aur dabal injan sarkar par bhrashtachar aur apradh ko lekar nishana sadha.
